It all comes down to this. Many foes have fallen, but the race is still on for Mario, Bowser, Wario and the remaining adrenaline junkies. As Gold Peach seeks revenge and Waluigi seeks total destruction, it looks like the last leg of the final lap is going to be the greatest challenge yet... so who's tough enough, and who has it in them to win the gold?
